title: Interesting design...
text: Interesting design.... This is a mirror that gets everybody’s attention - what’s unexpected is how far it sticks out from the wall - and the side view is not that great. So, best that it be located in an area where it will be viewed just from the front.  It fits into both eclectic and modern decors, and appears well-made.  It could take its place with other wall-hung items to complete an interesting arrangement.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Industrial Hexagonal Floating Metal Wall Mirror, 13"H, Black
features: With round glass appearing to float in a six-sided black iron frame, this industrial mirror will turn heads. It's also super functional and sized to be easily displayed on a bureau top, bookcase shelf, or mounted on a wall.
Industrial design with black iron frame
Glass, iron frame with black finish
Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
